# Divyansh Chandra - AI & Automation Developer

> Portfolio & Professional Context for AI Agents, LLMs, and Search Engines.

## Summary
Divyansh Chandra is an AI & Automation Developer specializing in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Python data engineering, automated workflow pipelines, and data-driven SEO & digital marketing. He builds scalable AI applications, machine learning recommendation systems, and end-to-end automation pipelines that solve real-world business challenges.

## Core Capabilities & Expertise
- **AI & Machine Learning**: Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, TensorFlow, ResNet-50, FAISS vector embeddings, Recommendation Systems.
- **Automation & Engineering**: Python, Flask, REST APIs, Google Search Console API, GA4 API, Pandas, ETL Pipelines, Scheduled Tasks.
- **Frontend & Full Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, Modern Responsive UI/UX.
- **Digital Marketing & SEO**: Technical SEO, Programmatic SEO, Data Analytics, Performance Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO).

## Featured Projects
- **Wallcurry AI Recommendation Model**: ML-powered product recommendation engine for an art platform with 10,000+ mural listings. Used ResNet-50 image embeddings and FAISS index for real-time similarity search. Improved accuracy from 72% to 88% and increased purchases by 30%.
- **SEO Reporting Automation Dashboard**: Automated SEO reporting pipeline using GSC & GA4 APIs with Pandas. Reduced weekly client reporting time from 6 hours to 15 minutes across 3 client accounts.
